claim_en: THE OWNERSHIP GATE. Conquered, divided, and KNOWN — only then; Jerusalem exempt; on-land only; the good-news reading.
middah: plain (the ownership gate — conquered, divided, and known, each token a condition; Jerusalem exempt; on the land only; the good-news reading)

claim_en: THE HUMILITY PROTOCOL. The owner himself; the two recorded causes; ke-nega even from the expert (Onkelos keeps the particle); the dark house never inspected.
middah: plain (the humility protocol — the owner himself, the two recorded causes, 'like a mark' even from the expert with the received translation keeping the particle, ink, beside; the dark house never inspected)

claim_en: THE EVACUATION. Everything out; the earthenware sermon; immediate defilement inside; the grace days.
middah: plain (the evacuation — everything out, the earthenware sermon, immediate defilement inside, the grace days)

claim_en: THE GEOMETRY GATE. Two beans, four walls (round and triangular exempt), the corner spec; stones-wood-dust or no house; the lintel station.
middah: plain (the geometry gate — two beans, four walls with round and triangular exempt, the corner spec, stones-wood-dust, the lintel station)

claim_en: THE SHARED WALL. Both neighbors pull and carry — woe to the wicked's neighbor; the plaster his alone; other stones, other dust.
middah: M-12 ('they shall take out' — both neighbors pull and carry, woe to the wicked's neighbor; the plaster his alone; other stones, other dust)

claim_en: THE TEN HOUSES. The complete decision tree numbered by the Sifra itself; return = two beans without spread; the corner-stone asymmetry.
middah: plain (the ten houses — the complete decision tree numbered by the Sifra itself; return is two beans without spread; the corner-stone asymmetry)

claim_en: THE ENTRY QUANTUM. Head-and-majority; the half-loaf interval, the Torah's one lenient wash; only the defilable save; the full certification + the teacher's license.
middah: plain (the entry quantum — head and majority; the half-loaf interval, the Torah's one lenient wash; only the defilable save; the certification and the teacher's license)
